nodes.summary: Let $\mu$ be any measure on a topological space $X$ and $E \subseteq X$. If for every $\varepsilon > 0$ there is an open set $U \supseteq E$ with $\mu(U \setminus E) \le \varepsilon$ (outer measure), then there is a $G_\delta$ set $G \supseteq E$ (a countable intersection of open sets) with $\mu(G \setminus E) = 0$: take $G = \bigcap_n U_n$ with $\mu(U_n \setminus E) \le 1/n$.
nodes.title: Open outer approximation gives a $G_\delta$ hull

nodes.title: Lebesgue measurability by outer approximation

nodes.summary: Let $\mu$ be a measure on a topological space $X$ whose Borel sets are measurable, and let $E \subseteq X$. If for every $\varepsilon > 0$ there is an open set $U \supseteq E$ with $\mu(U \setminus E) \le \varepsilon$ (outer measure), then $E$ is null-measurable. No regularity or finiteness of $\mu$ is needed.
nodes.title: Tao's definition of Lebesgue measurability implies null-measurability

nodes.summary: Let $\mu$ be a measure on a topological space $X$ whose Borel sets are measurable. If $E \subseteq G$ for a $G_\delta$ set $G$ with $\mu(G \setminus E) = 0$, then $E$ is null-measurable: $E = G \setminus (G \setminus E)$ is a Borel set minus a null set.
nodes.title: Subsets of a $G_\delta$ set with null difference are measurable

can_prove.label: ready to prove

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
